R. Q. 1 فَحْفَحَ : see the preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- Also, [inf. n. فَحْفَحَةٌ,] (assumed tropical:) He (a man, TA) was, or became, affected with a hoarseness, roughness, harshness, or gruffness, in his voice. (K.) [See also فَحْفَحَةٌ, below.] ＝
-A2- And He (a man, TA) was, or became, true and sincere in love, or affection. (IAar, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
